Preserve the original initializer first-argmax q/L/candidate; if its intended instance cannot be associated unambiguously, record target-association U rather than switching to a GT-best detection/annotation.
recommended_one_next_source.credible_mask_definition: A SAM2 candidate image-membership mask indexed by that source annotation, visually audited against the target body and competing instances. It is a predicted auxiliary ownership proposal, not official visible/amodal GT or D/E gold.
recommended_one_next_source.occluder_ownership_source: Other official instance IDs/bboxes provide competitor identity candidates. Separately prompted/audited other-instance masks can support foreign ownership; overlaps, merged pallets, incomplete annotation and unannotated foreground stay unresolved. Do not assume complete owner coverage.
bounded_next_step_not_executed: Retain all existing20frames/160logical query slots, including no-query/OOB, and original source folds/family grouping. Freeze the20target annotation IDs/bboxes and existing positive own-cue witnesses before SAM outputs; no new RGB or query selection.

Prospectively allow one target-mask output per frame using cached SAM2.1, multimask_output=False. Optionally freeze at most one largest-overlap other-annotation competitor per frame (tie lowest ann_id) before outputs: at most40mask calls, all missing/failures retained.

Save full-resolution native masks and exact original-query stencil membership, with source-target association and overlapping-owner uncertainty separate. Audit the fixed raw/context crops and mask leaks/holes; do not rank masks by GT or model correctness.

Initially this can supply conditional target-owned visible-support evidence.
